I'm still seeing a bunch of posts claiming to have been moved in "new and updated" - the same threads keep coming up like that as well as some new ones.

It's pretty irritating because clicking the "view topic" link doesn't take you to the first new post, and you end up having to find where you've already read to manually. It also doesn't show how many new posts, or who relied last, or any other useful information.

Sonething's obviously not right. Why does the forum keep repeatedly telling us a thread has been moved every time instead of saying it's been updated?

New and Updated only shows threads which have posts you haven't read yet.
